name: change the default login shell of a user and persist it
definition: Set a user's default shell so a user-database lookup reports the new shell as default.
failure_mode: Shell is installed but never set as default, so the account lookup still reports the old shell.

name: combine values from reference clues to produce an expected payload
definition: perform a numerical/string transform defined among scattered artifacts to produce the value a service expects.
failure_mode: wrong arithmetic yields an incorrect payload to the service
